entries.subject: electric vehicles
entries.quote: Passenger electric vehicle (EV) sales are set to grow rapidly in the next few years, rising from 6.6 million sold in 2021 to 21 million in 2025.
entries.note: Base-year value as stated in the edition. Not a projection.

entries.subject: electric vehicles
entries.quote: Passenger electric vehicle (EV) sales are set to grow rapidly in the next few years, rising from 6.6 million sold in 2021 to 21 million in 2025.
entries.note: The release does not name the scenario for this sentence; ETS is BNEF's base case in this edition.

entries.subject: electric vehicles
entries.metric: zero-emission share of new passenger vehicle sales, global
entries.quote: zero-emission vehicles need to represent 61% of global new passenger vehicle sales by 2030, 93% by 2035, and the last ICE vehicle of any segment needs to be sold by 2038
entries.note: Normative net-zero requirement, not a forecast.

notes: Scenarios: Economic Transition Scenario (ETS, main) and Net Zero Scenario (NZS). BNEF's public release gives no ETS sales share for 2030 or 2040 and no price parity year. A BNEF blog of 2022-08-30 repeats 'close to 21 million' in 2025. EV fleet in ETS: 77 million by 2025, 229 million by 2030 (not captured as scope is sales). Partial.
